title: Lo-Fi
tagline: Rough edges and intimate recording that make the process part of the sound.
summary: Lo-fi describes music whose recording texture retains audible imperfections, room sound, or inexpensive equipment character. In independent scenes, these qualities can create an intimate, handmade feel rather than polished studio sheen. Lo-fi appears across styles, from home-recorded indie pop to hip-hop beats and experimental music.

pillars.name: Guided by Voices
pillars.why: Guided by Voices became known for prolific songwriting and deliberately rough, home-recorded releases.

pillars.name: Daniel Johnston
pillars.why: Johnston's intimate recordings and direct songwriting became a touchstone for independent lo-fi music.

pillars.name: Sebadoh
pillars.why: Sebadoh's inexpensive recording approach and candid songwriting helped define an influential indie lo-fi sound.
